purpose: Invitation illustration revisions, ceremony artwork and transparent-background adaptations.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished NEW Sagai / engagement ring-ceremony illustration for a traditional Indian wedding invitation. Image 1 is a reference for the ring-exchange pose and the cream-and-pink wardrobe. Image 2 is a reference for the refined painted floral invitation-art style and clean transparent cutout treatment. An adult Indian groom in an elegant ivory-gold sherwani, without a turban, gently places a ring onto the bride's left-hand ring finger. The adult bride wears a blush-pink embroidered lehenga and graceful dupatta. Show both full figures with natural proportions, softly rendered faces, clear believable hands and an intimate warm expression. Delicate pink and cream flowers, restrained green foliage and a fine gold/floral arch frame the couple. A small natural petal-and-flower base under their feet; soft late-morning lighting matching an 11:30 AM engagement. The complete couple and floral frame should fill most of a balanced portrait canvas about 4:5 with a modest transparent margin, no cropped heads, feet or floral edges. This must be a self-contained transparent PNG cutout: genuine alpha in all empty spaces, through the arch and outside the artwork. No opaque pink rectangle, no coloured backdrop, no garden scenery, no background glow. Keep the style coherent with romantic pastel Indian wedding invitation illustrations. No garland-exchange pose, no wedding fire ritual, no floating giant rings, no words, lettering, dates, signs, logos or watermark. Return only the complete illustration, not a card page or mockup.

Create a TRANSPARENT-BACKGROUND STICKER CUTOUT from the attached wedding illustration. This is a background-removal edit, not a new background. Keep the bride, groom, their garland-exchange pose and clothes, floral pillars and the horizontal gold arch bar, flowers, gold lamps and a small petal-covered base exactly in this painted style. DELETE THE ENTIRE MINT BACKGROUND. All empty space must be genuinely transparent alpha: above the horizontal bar, within the opening of the arch behind the couple, between the people and the side pillars, outside the flowers, and around the complete outer silhouette. There must be NO coloured backdrop, NO blurred garden, NO bokeh, NO gradient, NO sky, NO background glow and NO rectangular floor or image panel. Retain only the foreground objects and small organic petal-covered ground at their feet, surrounded by transparent empty pixels. Keep all people full length, preserve the floral frame and lamps, and leave a modest transparent margin. The deliverable is a clean PNG sticker with genuine alpha that can be placed onto a dark purple webpage without revealing any background rectangle. No checkerboard pattern drawn into the image. No new elements, no letters, no labels, no text or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished replacement Baraat Prasthan (wedding party departure) BUS illustration for an Indian wedding invitation. The bus must be the main subject: a beautiful, realistic, well-proportioned single-deck ivory wedding coach, seen in a clear three-quarter view with its front toward the lower right. Show the ENTIRE bus with all its body and wheels inside the canvas. Decorate it tastefully with pink, cream and marigold flowers and blush ribbons; keep the windows and vehicle structure believable and clearly readable. A groom in ivory-gold sherwani with a peach turban stands on the ground near its passenger door, with two family members wishing him well and one dhol musician celebrating nearby. Family passengers may be subtly visible seated through a few windows. All people must be on the ground or seated inside; NO people standing on the roof. No bride, no horse, no car. Graceful Indian wedding departure mood, warm late-afternoon lighting, detailed elegant florals, soft painted illustration style that matches a pastel traditional invitation. Use a balanced tightly fitted near-square composition: the bus and small family group fill about 90 percent of the canvas, with small even transparent margins and no large unused top area. Genuine transparent background around the complete scene, natural clean alpha edges, no rectangular peach backdrop. Keep foreground flowers restrained so the bus remains prominent. No text, letters, numbers, route signs, logos, vehicle brands, dates, labels or watermarks. Decorative wedding illustration, not a real booking or venue photograph. Return only the full illustration, not a card or mockup.
